summary: Independent source and fixed frozen-runtime review passes the bounded W14.05 contract after rework-1. W14.05-R1 is resolved: trusted session-link preflight now selects the same own-browser cookie/pointer fallback as the host, detecting deterministic enrichment conflicts before identity writes. Archived prior FAIL remains unchanged. Lead retains acceptance authority.

criteria.evidence: Reuse prior complete source review of the seven unchanged source/doc files and inspect current two-file rework. Strict streamed/bounded typed snapshots, canonical original-time replacement/withdrawal/stale/replay/conflict, co-located state and validated per-row accounting remain intact. Both hosts compute subject batches before persistence; profile-only imports retain behavioral vectors/visit metadata, replay does not write, and only applied behavioral rows increment noteHistory. Current fixed runtime renews schema/bounds, replacement/replay, mixed counts and pure/mixed injected-write failure assertions; all 52 unchanged legacy cases pass.

R1 closed on actual source and runtime: link.ts:127-133 now uses the public ownedSource unchanged or own(cookie) ?? own(visitor pointer), matching the host's own-browser identity/user selection. Missing and non-owned/person cookies fall back before pure merge/store.link; strict read errors still throw, with prior already/repoint/forward guards retained. Existing group3 now verifies both expired-cookie and person-cookie conflicting imports reject with no put/delete and exact KV unchanged. Reused unchanged reviewed C2 consumers and guards: current namespaced typed/local/reflex/allowed ODP/precomputed memberships on both hosts; fresh read-only qualification/tick; no stale stage-pinning memberships in three enriched live/alarm tails; no raw enrichment spread into decision attributes; co-located reconstruction/erasure; explicit stored import consent/exact selectors/cutoffs; existing valid owner preservation for pure/mixed typed imports; commit-first DO mirrors. Current two-host/two-tenant read/live/restarted-alarm, merge/repoint/conflict/overflow, refusal and erasure cases all pass.

Original plan/contract unchanged; rework admission limits edits to link.ts and existing SDK group3, confirmed by exact prior-frozen/current diff. Seven other owned source/doc hashes and 36 protected pins remain unchanged. Verified all 50 current manifest pins before/after runtime, exact contract/artifact digest, all nine baseline/current forward and reverse patches, and five archived prior artifacts/review hashes. Exactly three grouped additions remain; legacy identity/direct fixtures and named W37.04 preserved. Independent fixed compound ran once on this frozen artifact: 52 plus 4 selected PASS, 38 SDK cases intentionally unselected. Reused inspected final worker compiler98355/9763d4 and lint60965/45ffed, both exit0/drained; normalized 122 warnings exactly match prior candidate (123 baseline, no additions). Scoped whitespace981bd4 exit0; literal new-file e76a49 exit1/no diagnostics accurately distinguished. Prior source FAIL, worker failures/superseded results and prospective W05.09 qualification retained.

findings.resolution: Trusted preflight applies the same own-cookie then own-user-pointer selection as the host before merge/store.link. Missing and person-session cookies select the actual browser source and conflicting snapshots refuse before any identity write. Exact group3 destination/KV assertions passed in independent53739/3a0974.
findings.limitation: Deterministic selection/preflight correction only, not cross-store or concurrent identity/erasure atomicity.

rework_basis.previous_source_assurance: Prior actual nine-file source review is reused only for unchanged bytes; both rework files and updated fixed group3 were inspected directly. Five archival hashes verified, original49 worker captures preserved exactly.
